name: dirtbid-video
description: DirtBid animated promo video built with Remotion

scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:square && npm run render:wide
scripts.still:endcard: remotion still DirtBid-Square out/endcard-thumbnail-1x1.png --frame 1790 && remotion still DirtBid-Wide out/endcard-thumbnail-16x9.png --frame 1790 && remotion still DirtBid-Vertical out/endcard-thumbnail-9x16.png --frame 1790
scripts.render:collage:wide: remotion render Collage-Wide out/dirtbid-collage-16x9.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency 4 --color-space bt709
scripts.render:collage:vertical: remotion render Collage-Vertical out/dirtbid-collage-9x16.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency 4 --color-space bt709
scripts.render:collage:square: remotion render Collage-Square out/dirtbid-collage-1x1.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency 4 --color-space bt709
scripts.render:collage: npm run render:collage:wide && npm run render:collage:vertical && npm run render:collage:square
scripts.still:collage: remotion still Collage-Wide out/collage-endcard-16x9.png --frame 1740 && remotion still Collage-Square out/collage-endcard-1x1.png --frame 1740 && remotion still Collage-Vertical out/collage-endcard-9x16.png --frame 1740
scripts.master: node tools/audio/master.mjs out/dirtbid-collage-16x9.mp4 && node tools/audio/master.mjs out/dirtbid-collage-9x16.mp4 && node tools/audio/master.mjs out/dirtbid-collage-1x1.mp4
